question: Where is the office of the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank of India, and its headquarters is located in Mumbai.
 
• The RBI was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• Mumbai, being the financial capital of India, houses the offices of many significant financial institutions, including the RBI.
